info.name: Veritify API
info.description:
Official Postman collection for the Veritify API — verifiable signal integrity and novelty detection for data streams.

Quick start:
1. Run **Signup** first to get an `api_key` (or set the `api_key` collection variable if you already have one).
2. Copy the returned key into the `api_key` collection variable — every other authenticated request reads it from there.
3. Try **Mine (single mode)** with any small text/audio file.

Docs: https://github.com/PantaleonSystems/veritify-python/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md
SDK: https://pypi.org/project/veritify/

variable.description: Paste the key returned by Signup here. Leave empty to call /mine anonymously (shared rate limit).

request.description:
Self-service — no authentication required. The returned `api_key` is shown exactly once; copy it into the `api_key` collection variable right away.

Errors: 409 (email already has an active key), 422 (malformed email), 429 (too many signups from your IP).

Upload a file and get back its integrity/novelty verdict. Attach any small audio, text, or document file in the `file` form field.

Errors: 401/403 (secure-mode auth), 413 (too large), 422 (empty/corrupt/unsupported), 429, 503, 504.
Same endpoint as single mode, but with a `question` field — compares the file against the question instead of scoring it alone. Returns a `verdict` field with one of 5 closed values.

variable.description: 64-char hex SHA-256 receipt_hash from a previous Mine response

request.description: Public, no API key required. Always returns 200 — `known: false` for a hash never seen, never a 404. Only a malformed hash (wrong length/non-hex) returns 422.
Requires the `api_key` collection variable to be set. Returns total_calls / first_used_at / last_used_at for that key. A key that's never been used returns total_calls=0, not an error.
No /api/v1 prefix — mounted at the root, unlike the other endpoints. No API key required.
Aggregate, instance-wide counters — no /api/v1 prefix, no API key required.
